0022600109.text: The Spurs (0-1, 11th in the West, 5th in the Southwest) visit the Mavericks (1-1, 8th in the West, 3rd in the Southwest), with San Antonio still winless after its only game, a home loss. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Spurs won all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently 139-120 in San Antonio on April 10. San Antonio will be without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), while Dallas will be without Cooper Flagg (shoulder soreness) and Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), and Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Jett Howard (calf soreness), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation) are day-to-day with game-time decisions.
